title: 第十一章 城外山谷第十二章 入谷
content_zh:
李言此时已跟着季军师来到了校军场大门处，刚出得了大门，季军师看了一眼远处那一片等候的人群，便在大门处站住了身形。
李言这时也跟了出来，还不待他开口，季军师已转头看向他，微笑说道。
“那里等候的人中是否有送你来此之人？”
李言赶紧答道。
“老师明鉴，是在下的一位长辈送弟子来此应征入伍的。”
“哦，那你前去和他说上一声，然后便跟我离去。”
季军师挥了挥手。
“是！多谢老师。”
李言向季军师躬身一礼后，便大步向李国新所在人群处走去。
校场门口几名守卫军卒听到这二人对话，已是知道眼前这黑皮小子已拜入了季军师门下，他们当然知道季军师择选弟子的挑剔，不由对李言羡慕不已。
若是他躲得再慢些，那凶兽之尾必自他太阳穴而贯入脑部，那只有惨死当场的份了。
“那便好，那这便随我回府去吧。”
那小头目模样的人，见到季军师过来，远远的忆是叉手行礼。
眼看又到了北城门，李言不由得心中一愣，难道这军师府在这城门附近不成，但他马上就知道自己猜错了，因为季军师没有丝毫停留拐弯之意。而是径直向着城门走去。
一片很大的空地显现出来，方圆约莫有百十丈来许，这片空地周围参天大树层层环抱，只有正对着他们上来的石阶处留出一条两三人宽的石径小道。
待他二人去到城门外时，那里有七八名军卒在一小头目模样人带领下，正在盘查过往行人。
他心中有个疑问，就是为什么季军师能看上李言？
待得季军师二人出得北门而去后，那头目模样的人看着李言的背影自言自语道。
季军师听罢一笑。
每天这样来回不用车马，得走多长时间？虽然几十里路对他来说也不是什么难事，但是想想经常这样来去不免枯燥了些。”

中间诺大的场地上亦被青石碎块平整的铺满，在一些地方还挂有沙袋，建有沙坑之类的东西，但都是整齐划一。
但凡进入之人十入九死，即使是江湖绝顶高手也不敢过多深入。
那名小头目恭喜完毕，便自觉地退了回去，心中已然念头飞转，想着找个机会得与季军师这刚收的弟子亲近亲近了。
李言仔细一看，原来此处有一条山路向西侧山脉中延伸而入。
不大一会，便有十几人纷纷从两旁青石屋内来到了场地中央。
这城外只有一条大道向北延伸，也就是李言之前进城的大道，两侧都是深山密林。
“大人回来了，大家出来下！”
刚才季军师站在门口时，已经有不少人认了出来，见李言和他一起出来，并且季军师还向李言低语。
李言一肚子的疑惑，但还是默不作声的跟在了身后。
而除了这些军卒外，这里竟然还有三名中年妇人。
他听村里大人们说过官员大人们出去是何种排场、何等的威风，有些严苛的还要净街驱民。
即使他果断地退了出来，手下也死伤大半，他自己脸上同样被一凶兽尾部扫中，留下一道狰狞的疤痕。
转身快步走向马车取了自己的包裹，一折身又向校军场大门口走去。
这就已经引起不少人的注意，当李言之前过来后，不少人可就全神关注起来。
李言自小在村里长大，乃是他看着长大的，过人之处他可从来没看出来。
再加之李国新那副吃惊呆滞的表情，即使原本觉得没什么的人，看到那副表情后，也会有所联想了。
然后，他径直沿着校军场院墙向一个方向而去，只是走了几步他感觉身后的李言东张西望时，不由稍顿了一下。
李言跟着季军师此时已来到北城门处。
content_en:
At this time, Li Yan had followed Ji Junshi to the gate of the school military field. As soon as he got out of the gate, Ji Junshi glanced at the waiting crowd in the distance and stopped at the gate.
Li Yan also followed out at this time. Before he could speak, Master Ji turned to look at him and said with a smile.
"Is there anyone waiting there who sent you here?"
Li Yan quickly replied.
"Teacher Mingjian, one of my elders sent this disciple here to enlist in the army."
"Oh, then go and talk to him, and then leave with me."
The third division commander waved his hand.
"Yes! Thank you teacher."
After Li Yan bowed to Master Ji, he strode towards the crowd where Li Guoxin was.
When several soldiers guarding the school gate heard the conversation between the two men, they already knew that the black-skinned boy in front of them had become the disciple of Master Ji. Of course, they knew that Master Ji was picky in choosing his disciples, and they couldn't help but be envious of Li Yan.
If he had been slower to hide, the tail of the beast would have penetrated from his temple into his brain, and he would have died miserably on the spot.
"That's fine, then just follow me back home."
When the little boss-looking man saw Master Ji approaching, he crossed his arms and saluted from a distance.
Seeing that he had arrived at the North City Gate again, Li Yan couldn't help but wonder. Could it be that the Military Advisor's Mansion was near the city gate? But he immediately knew that he had guessed wrong, because Military Advisor Ji had no intention of stopping and turning around. Instead, he walked straight towards the city gate.
A large open space appeared, with a radius of about a hundred feet. This open space was surrounded by layers of towering trees, and only a stone path two or three people wide was left at the stone steps facing them.
When the two of them arrived outside the city gate, there were seven or eight soldiers there, led by a small leader-like person, checking the passers-by.
There was a question in his mind, why did Master Ji fall in love with Li Yan?
After the two military divisions of the Ji Dynasty left the north gate, the leader-looking man looked at Li Yan's back and muttered to himself.
The third division commander smiled after hearing this.
How long does it take to go back and forth every day without a carriage or horse? Although it is not difficult for him to travel dozens of miles, it is a bit boring to think about going back and forth like this often. "
The large field in the middle is also flatly covered with bluestone fragments. In some places, there are sandbags hung and sand pits and the like, but they are all neat and uniform.
Anyone who enters is likely to die, and even the best masters in the world do not dare to go too deep.
After the young leader congratulated him, he consciously stepped back. Thoughts were already racing in his mind, thinking of finding an opportunity to get close to the newly recruited disciple, Master Ji.
Li Yan took a closer look and found that there was a mountain road extending into the mountains on the west side.
After a while, more than a dozen people came to the center of the venue from the bluestone houses on both sides.
There is only one avenue outside the city extending northward, which is the avenue that Li Yanyan used to enter the city. There are deep mountains and dense forests on both sides.
"My lord is back, everyone, come out! "
When Master Ji was standing at the door just now, many people recognized him and saw Li Yan coming out with him, and Master Ji even whispered to Li Yan.
Li Yan was puzzled, but he still followed behind him silently.
In addition to these soldiers, there were actually three middle-aged women here.
He heard from the adults in the village what kind of pomp and majesty the officials had when they went out. Some of them were so strict that they had to clear the streets to drive away the people.
Even if he retreated decisively, most of his men were killed or injured. He himself was also struck by the tail of a ferocious beast, leaving a ferocious scar.
He turned around and walked quickly to the carriage to pick up his package, then turned around and walked towards the gate of the school military field.
This has attracted the attention of many people. When Li Yan came over before, many people paid full attention.
Li Yan grew up in the village, and he was the one who watched him grow up, but he never saw the difference between him and others.
In addition, Li Guoxin looked stunned and stunned.The expression, even people who originally thought it was nothing, will have some associations after seeing that expression.
Then, he walked straight in one direction along the wall of the school military field. After only walking a few steps, he couldn't help but pause for a moment when he felt Li Yan behind him looking around.
Li Yan followed Ji Junshi to the north city gate.
